notes: Skill was workable. Friction: (1) the skill says reviewers read the --redact copy but the sandbox did not permit the shell to write files for integrity_scan --redact, so the scan was run to stdout only (clean) and reviewers read the original text. (2) Phase 1.5 literature check is specified as running after Phase 1 reports are drafted, but in a single-context sequential run the searches have to be done before writing any report text; I read the paper, ran 7 searches (budget-limited, benchmarks/scout/coverage subcommands skipped) and then wrote all reports. (3) The aggregate script's composite band (2) disagreed with the weighted rating (3) near a band edge; the EIC rules say a one-step disagreement near an edge is not a reason to depart, which was applicable and clear. (4) ICLR scale output 'rating 4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}' for final Overall 3 is a secondary-status label; both ICLR scales are printed and the summary field carries both. (5) Strict mode left few comparable prior abstracts for a baseline scout table on a benchmark paper whose tasks are public datasets, so that table could not be built. (6) The DA instructions allow 'No CRITICAL issues found'; this paper had confounds and text-table contradictions but none met the strict criteria (selection of Reverse on the test split fell in the MAJOR rows of the criterion-3 table).
